Public contract tests preceded implementation; added transaction cases and an initially failing import-identity regression now pass. The resulting runtime bundle is byte-identical to the pre-change artifact under the same inputs. Prior source was read; this is not a no-access clean-room assertion. Public option names, output paths, esbuild settings, environment identifiers and standard Node interop are compatibility constraints, not evidence of original authorship. esbuild remains a third-party compiler. This record covers only the listed file, not inherited configuration, standard license text, remaining host modules or the whole application.

Prior access to existing source is disclosed, not a no-access clean-room claim; equivalent behavior and different hashes alone do not establish provenance. Zod remains an attributed third-party runtime. Changes to build scripts and manifests are scoped integration fixes, not independently classified here.
